place.source_title: Canopy shelter at the pier-foot bus stop (Navy Pier)

brief: A small open shelter of red steel posts under a flat red canopy with lamps, benches beneath. One photo. Piles carried 10 m below the modelled bed (spec rule 4).

facade.notes: the Navy Pier bus turnaround (c.1995): a row of open shelters, each a pair of red steel tree-like posts curving up to a shallow green hipped canopy with a hanging lamp, benches and concrete footings; city buses waiting at the curb, snow

why.note: bus and tram stops: a row of identical open canopies along the curb, as long as the buses that load at once
